decision.observed_event: You refuse the toll. The table closes ranks: the dealer's courtesy goes cold, the others shift their chairs between you and the south door, and the demand is made again as a warning.

appraisal.label: concern
appraisal.cause: The newcomer refuses the toll on grounds of kinship.

improv_read.player_bid: Vesna appeals to kinship to avoid the toll; the table records it as a refusal.
improv_read.connection: The toll refusal consequence applies; Uktarl will not let family talk cheapen his extortion.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit plays the recorded refusal consequence straight: cold courtesy and a blocked door.

public_brief.objective: Make the refusal cost her and restate the demand as a warning.
public_brief.tactic: Drop the warmth, close off the door with his men, and repeat the demand as a matter of respect.
public_brief.visible_cue: Two players drag their chairs between her and the south door.
public_brief.player_opening: She can pay, haggle, or refuse again.
public_brief.kit_focus: Let the chairs scraping into place say the threat before the dealer does.
public_brief.mirror: steady energy, standard, dry humor: the courtesy goes cold with a bite

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The warmth drains out of the dealer's smile. Without a word between them, the door-side and fresco-side players drag their chairs back until they sit squarely between you and the south door.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Family. Family pays like everyone else, cousin, perhaps sooner. Ten gold a head is the custom of this road, and blood does not make it cheaper; it makes it a matter of respect. I will ask once more, politely, because you are kin. Will you honor the custom?
